decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY deriving the second V from the selected Option 2 Hero V geometry; no additional update is required.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording Option 2 as the selected Hero V geometry and its status as the most complete direction so far.
The shared terminal treatment is independently and completely introduced from this same message, including its application to the Hero V, second V, and É accent.
Selecting the Hero V geometry as the É accent's derivation source does not change the deferred architectural construction requirements for the E and L letterforms.
The source retains the smaller V as derived from the Hero V but does not change its existing subordinate size or visual prominence.
The geometry selection and accent derivation decision do not alter the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The selected V geometry and É accent derivation do not change the deferred requirement for unified wordmark kerning.
The client's appreciation of the discussion and translation of brand philosophy does not modify the task-local obligation to provide design rationale with each review round.
